15. General Equilibrium under Uncertainty

State-contingent commodities and Arrow–Debreu equilibrium — the mutuality principle of full insurance and the scarcity premium in state prices.

  • Arrow–Debreu Equilibrium — An Edgeworth box in state-contingent consumption space. With no aggregate risk, both consumers sit on the 45-degree line in equilibrium — full insurance (mutuality principle). Move the aggregate-risk slider and everyone tracks the aggregate.
  • State Prices and Scarcity — Probabilities vs. state prices across three states, side by side. State prices are marginal-utility-weighted probabilities, not raw probabilities — a dollar in the scarcest state costs the most (numbers above the bars: qs/πsq_s/\pi_sqs​/πs​).
